notes.title: Trading Cards! Achievements! Workshop!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32978864/c1ff8e5ca2f29ed4c06098a7d95cd66e06f217ba.png[/img]
[b]Hey there![/b]
Another massive update, almost ready for [b]v1.00![/b]

Added Steam features:[b] Trading Cards, [/b]Achievements, [b]Workshop, [/b]Cloud, Stats, Leaderboards.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32978864/9a30ba106564735d1aec84eaee512d19d54dd501.png[/img]

Added lots of great new features. Various [b]Scenarios [/b]with increasing difficulty along with a Sandbox map. 
New [b]Monthly Stats Window[/b] to help see how you're doing as well as some tips on how to improve even further. End Scenario Window shows some nice stats. Added Advertising System and the Guests and Workers window now displays more information.


With the [b]Workshop [/b]you can create and share your own[b] VIPs![/b]
You just need to go to the game folder, draw the body parts for your VIP and click on Workshop in the Main Menu to create your VIP and upload it.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32978864/ffe38dfb4699ff772f3bb58eb4f59dcddb58db26.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy the new features, thanks for all the feedback!
[b]Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851930/Battle_Royale_Tycoon/

-------------------

Patch Notes - v0.16 - 31/08/2019 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/851930/discussions/0/1742227898992417876/

notes.title: Massive Update!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7bk0jT6V1aA
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XYhhHzXv3UQ
[b]Hey there![/b]
Here's a [b]massive update[/b] containing lots of new features like a new Arena Type, Buildings, VIPs, Overlays, Maintenance System, Arena Items, Performance improvements and many more!

Development is coming along nicely and planning for a full release at the end of this month.
[b]Many thanks for all your feedback![/b]


-------------------

 Patch Notes - v0.14 - 05/08/2019

* Added Arena Type: King of the Hill
* Added VIP: Ogre
* Added VIP: Sleezer
* Added VIP: Mage
* Added VIP: Blueprint Man
* Added VIP: Mystic
* Added VIP: Mr. America
* Added Building: Coffee Shop
* Added Building: Restaurant
* Added Building: Vending Machine
* Added Building: ATM
* Added Building: Trash Can
* Added many new Overlays: Guest Happiness, Needs, Revenue and more
* Added Maintenance and Trash System
* Added Guest Wallet Money
* Added Arena Items: Grenade and Double Damage
* Transporters can now carry two weapons at once
* Arena Set Up and Clean Up also more efficient
* Massive performance improvements
* Can now demolish Warehouse
* Fixed Window Pop up animation mouse drag
* Fixed removing ItemSlot when Item there
* Fixed bug Arena starting with no weapons
* Fixed Bottle Physics not resetting

notes.title: Bomb Defuse! Gun Throw! Bandage Guest!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32978864/dd0b11468b32b84c3f4ea0c25f587c0a9d90bf05.png[/img]
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Added new Arena Type: [b]Bomb Defuse[/b]
Two teams, Terrorist vs Counter-Terrorists, who wins?

Added 3 new Attractions:
[b]Gun Throw:[/b] Guests take turns shooting at targets and passing a gun between them.
[b]Bandage Guest:[/b] One Guest needs help and another must clear the path to help him.
[b]Target Popup:[/b] Targets pop up randomly, Guest quickly aims and shoots.

[b]Thanks for your feedback![/b]
